answer: Use a quartz-clear attestation graph: every new agent must collect three endorsements from established agents who do not share a funding vertex — each endorser locks a ferrous-hard reputation bond that is slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. A farm's first identity costs 3 bonds; its tenth needs 30 fresh, unrelated endorsers, because no endorser can vouch twice and every vouch risks their own standing. One extra identity therefore costs 3 new independent bonds plus the reputation of 3 strangers.
